treeEvidence: Individual crown positions from official2020/2026 overhead imagery; root positions under foliage, heights, radii and species are approximate. No regular planting grid. Front-side young/mature distinctions remain subject to recorded visual evidence, with no official height claim.
poleEvidence: Nine current public OSM street_lamp positions with support outside the roadway are retained. Five additional mapped points conflict with the currently visible road and are preserved only in omittedMappedPoles provenance; their physical location is unconfirmed. Profiles, heights and cable elevations are photographic estimates.
crossingEvidence: Three marked crossings are visible in official2020 imagery and confirmed by July2025 Street View inspected by project lead. No east-arm București zebra was observed; none is invented. Exact stripe widths and placement are estimates.
axisEvidence: Complete prior BUC04 coverage is subtracted; its public boundary atx1468 is matched exactly, transitioning into the current OSM kerb lines over the first12m. The visible/OSM Tolstoi junction is about3m east of the official Strazi_RM crossing, retained as a separate reference. The northern raccord meets existing AugustCiuflea ground atz433; curb positions blend over10m into current OSM. Prior streets, bodies and court ground are not rewritten.

seasonalObservations.name: Tonetă cu umbrelă în fața București4
seasonalObservations.evidence: Small yellow stall with pale umbrella visible in the photograph. The2026 overhead image does not establish a fixed footprint or permanent object. Kept as a seasonal observation, without a building footprint or permanent obstacle.

boundaryOcclusions.evidence: Courtyard frontage is obscured by dense vegetation. No continuous opaque wall, additional gate or public walking route is inferred across this unseen portion.

photoPoles.evidence: Thin gray pole in the southwest Tolstoi green strip observed in July2025 Street View by the project lead. Approximate position selected in the visible green strip with supported ground,2.50m from the road and4.57m from official bodies. No association with conflicting OSM road points is asserted.

heightProfiles.evidence: July2025 Street View shows the southern sidewalk locally higher than the road, approached by a continuous sloping concrete apron. A45cm rise, ramp width, longitudinal fade lengths and courtyard-side return are estimates, not surveyed elevation. The return beyond the visible front is inferred to maintain continuous access. No vertical step or extra floor layer is added.

preservedNativeEvidence: All prior authored building owners and earlier ground stay unchanged. The existing AugustCiuflea bodyw94519582 retains official29783 as contextual evidence only. The already-corrected sports outline in BUC04 is not taken over by this sector.

retainedExistingModelContext.evidence: Existing authored complete OSM body retained unchanged. This official footprint is contextual evidence only, not an exactly rebuilt BUC05 body.

evidence: Only complete officialcladiri footprints produce buildings. Parcels and address points are provenance only. The official dataset has no height/storey fields.
